prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080. Composition must be SQUARE, never wide or landscape.

CRITICAL - READ FIRST: the drawing must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES with NO frame, NO border line, NO box and NO white margin band; the islet-cell shapes and the winding channel are CUT OFF by the image edge itself.

SCENE: A cheerful cartoon BETA CELL (the body's insulin factory) character delivers its round parcels down a chute into a wide winding channel inside its islet village.
- The BETA CELL is a big, plump, cushiony round character, standing large on a gentle diagonal and filling most of the picture. It has a BIG FRIENDLY FACE: two large round eyes with small solid pupils, cheerful curved eyebrows, rosy round cheeks and a wide happy open grin. Two short stubby arms with simple mitten hands and two little stubby feet.
- With one mitten hand it holds up a BIG ROUND PARCEL - a plain circle with a simple six-sided gem shape drawn inside it (an insulin parcel). With the other hand it tips a SIMPLE OPEN DELIVERY CHUTE (a short wide slide made of two curved lines), and TWO more big round parcels with gems inside are sliding down the chute.
- The chute ends at a WIDE OPEN CHANNEL that sweeps across the lower part of the picture and curves off the BOTTOM edge, drawn as two long simple curved bank lines with a few gentle wavy flow lines between them. The near bank has a short row of big simple oval portholes (the vessel's little doors).
- On the character's round tummy is one BIG ROUND PORTHOLE WINDOW (a plain circle) through which THREE smaller circles are visible side by side, each with a tiny six-sided gem inside - the parcel store.
- On the LEFT and RIGHT, the plump rounded bumps of two NEIGHBOUR ISLET-CELL characters press into the picture, each cut off by the left or right edge, each with its own simple happy face. Their rounded shoulders run off the left and right edges of the picture.
- Behind everything, two or three tall smooth arcs suggest the curving islet wall, running from the top area down and off the bottom corners; the arcs are cut off by the edges.
- Everything is drawn LARGE, SIMPLE and CHUNKY, with generous open white areas inside every shape so a child can colour them in.

STYLE - coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with plenty of white space.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN - the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion rays or halo of rays behind, around or under any character. NO radiating lines of any kind anywhere.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind. Do NOT draw a thin black line anywhere near the edge of the image. There must be NO white margin between the artwork and the image edge.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels, signatures or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO syringes, NO needles, NO blood drops, no wounds, no scary or angry faces, nothing gruesome.
- NO human figure and no hands other than the characters' own mitten hands.
- NO long wavy hairs, NO fur carpet and NO beating cilia anywhere.
